heroHeadline: DPRK Troops March on Red Square; Kim Orders Seoul-Targeting Artillery Deployment
heroSubtitle: North Korean troops publicly marched at Moscow's Victory Day parade for the first time in history on May 9, 2026, while Kim Jong-un ordered 60km-range artillery systems deployed to DMZ-area units targeting Seoul — the latest moves in DPRK's transformation from isolated state to active Russia alliance partner.
footerNote: Data sourced from US/ROK official reports, KCNA, UN panels, IAEA, and institutional analyses. North Korea does not publish national statistics — economic figures are estimates with wide uncertainty ranges.
